# `house_allowance_summary_pages`

**House annual allowance summary pages**

Selected original allowance table and formula-introduction pages with complete source readings and explicit unnormalized scope.

**Coverage.** Window. Explicitly selected retained native House report pages. Completion covers that selection only. Formula quantities, historical scanned tables and unselected pages remain outside normalized annual allowance coverage. *(measured 2026-11-06)*

**Data quality.** Annual allowance observations repeat across report quarters; do not add repeated annual tables or current and amended sections. Recipient labels can name people, vacant districts or caucuses. Preserve literal state/district codes, exact amount precision and source occurrences. A reviewed governed-year correction retains the printed header and title years with its source evidence. Formula pages retain source text and explicit unnormalized status.

- **Parquet file:** `house_allowance_summary_pages.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.
